name: Realm: windswept highlands (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic windswept upland photographed on location like a feature-film still - open grass ridges, sea cliffs and high passes, stone walls and windmills, racing cloud shadows, bright broken light and streaming grass and cloth; any magic is a faint ripple in the air; nothing from the modern world
notes: The wind homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/wind/ (set components.realm).
